request: The sequencing was performed on several plates over the course of a month. The experimental design includes biological groups on each plate, and the team has already checked that group and plate are not completely confounded. We want the analysis plan to make the adjustment explicit so that the downstream regulatory graph is based on the approved adjusted co-expression artifact. The manuscript will report which artifact is passed between steps, and the collaborator reviewing the plan will independently inspect the gene identifiers. We do not need you to interpret any disease association in this request. Can we use a COBRA adjusted co-expression matrix in aggregate PANDA for a coastal fish cohort? We retain the original expression table and priors and will revalidate filtered gene IDs before the handoff.
